display_name: LoRa W24 adaptive receive-noise readout (Full only)
description: One receive-only smooth strength for frozen W24 outer-objective edits, compared with identical fixed-half direction.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and latest user instruction limiting the current run to Full practical.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Matching 300 source V opaque IDs and original 30,000 Full target packet order, if qualified.
data.validation_ref: Prior frozen exact source-packet replay and original same-packet clean/direct/half coordinates.
data.leo_config_ref: Only the registered native Full circuit and clean with existing W24 physical coordinates.

permissions.claim_scope: No fitting. The candidate uses only current received IQ and frozen source-only weights. No noise traces or source labels until independent fixed-prediction scoring.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original compliant frozen source models, no dynamic weights, no training or calibration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Preset gain g = .5 + q/(q+.275^2), q = chirp-power-weighted native out-of-band noise estimate. Full source gate: at least +18/1800 overall and +10/300 in low urban versus frozen same-weight half, clean correct count at least direct. Then automatically predict the same Full 30000-packet seven-scene matrix and score truth-last.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU for source; if qualified two available GPUs for the 3 Full shards, at most one task worker per GPU, 12 GiB actual free minimum. Prefer physical GPU 3,0 before 5,6.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on checkpoint, source physical order, actual paired control parity, gain range, target receipt/coverage, or scorer validation failure.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: w24_observed_dose score-source and independent local score_observed_dose

rows.method: Paired fixed-half control and measured-noise variable full-route readout with frozen DURA, direct comparison and archived controls.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: Zero parameter updates; full source panel first, conditional exact paired formal Full 30000 packets.

notes: Candidate and fixed-half control share exact direction and checkpoint. Q is measured by the existing receive-only FFT noise estimator; no isolated noise traces are used at any stage of this run.
The source threshold is fixed before this candidate sees source V predictions. Source scores are independent from prediction. Failed source runs are retained.
Full only according to the latest scope; current Full goals 162000/180000, 25500/30000 low urban and 28566/30000 clean.
